skill.name: Scanner
skill.description: Transform document photos into clean scanned-looking pages with automatic edge detection, cropping, and perspective correction. Use when (1) the user wants a photo to look scanned; (2) receipts, forms, pages, or papers need clean borders and straightening; (3) the result should be easier to read, share, archive, or pass to OCR.
skill.summary: When to Use Use when the user wants to scan a document from a photo, crop the page automatically, fix perspective, or make an image look like it came from a flatbed scanner. Load this skill when the request sounds like:
